statements.markdown: **Theorem 4.1 (mixed weighted and cover supports).** *Let $E,V\subseteq\mathbb{N}_{>0}$. Suppose $E$ satisfies [(W)](#eq:weighted-return) for a finite nonempty prime set $P$, and $V\subseteq\bigcup_jF_j$ for finite sets and nonnegative majorants satisfying the hypotheses of Theorem [3.1](#thm:variable-fractional-cover), with either [(V)](#eq:strengthened-cover) or its positive-weight variant. Then $X_A(b)$ is irrational for every infinite $A\subseteq E\cup V$ and every integer $b\ge2$.*
